description: This file defines the ThemeRegistry class in Drupal, responsible for managing the runtime theme registry with caching and lazy-loading features.

classes.name: ThemeRegistry
classes.description: Manages the theme registry with caching, lazy-loading, and cache invalidation mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ThemeRegistry object, setting up cache, lock, and registry data.

methods.name: initializeRegistry
methods.description: Fetches the full theme registry and initializes the local storage with NULL values.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a theme hook key exists in the registry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a theme hook's data, resolving cache miss if necessary.

methods.name: resolveCacheMiss
methods.description: Loads missing theme hook data from the complete registry and updates cache.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Persists the current state of the registry to cache, with optional locking.

methods.name: getPreprocessInvokes
methods.description: Returns the map of preprocess invoke functions.

methods.name: getGlobalPreprocess
methods.description: Returns the list of global preprocess callbacks.
